name: Clean And Unclean
overview: Scripture reveals the importance of discerning clean and unclean, both in physical and spiritual contexts, as God commands His people to distinguish holiness from profaneness. Leviticus 11 introduces God's instructions regarding clean and unclean animals, emphasizing obedience to His word, while Ezekiel 44 highlights the role of teaching this distinction to the people. This separation reflects a deeper call to live by God's Word alone, as exemplified by Christ in Matthew 4, and to avoid paths that appear right to man but lead to death, as warned in Proverbs 14. Ultimately, recognizing what is clean and unclean aligns believers with God's holiness and prepares them for His righteous judgment described in Isaiah 66.
